author: Thechaosmineral
quote: Let's see, can't steal cars, can't shoot up or run over protestors and gay club goers, lock at 30fps, tones of bug and glitches, the main protagonist is a submissive, bland, dull voiced little cardboard cuckholder simp to his Latino **** 'girlfriend' (who's a **** character and protagonist in her own right aswell by the way), took out being able to **** prostitute which has been a staple in this game series since it's creation, can't get npc's killed using the environment (e.g. train tracks and gators), the autosave doesn't work half the time or at all, the main story and side missions are all **** (seriously taking an actual real life **** is more fun than nearly all the missions I've played so far), the game likes to play with the idea that the romance missions are optional but the truth is there not really, planes don't properly explode and just phase through buildings and probably more dumb **** that I haven't come across yet, conclusion don't buy this piece of **** it completely inferior to the gems that came before it and is an active stain on the game series legacy now, and don't listen to what any gta 6 larpers have to say about this **** their just deluding themselves into thinking this slop is the quality game experience of all time because they're having an extremely very slow mental breakdown to the fact they just pre-ordered a woke garbage fire with an 80 quid price tag attach to it, if rockstar ever make a gta 7 they need to make sure that the pink and purple haired gorlocks that snort lattes all day at their desks are all exterminated and long gone and they need to have the gta 7 protagonist kill the two  protagonist of this 'game' Johnny Klebitz style, (seriously seeing these two protagonist get killed like Johnny Klebitz in gta 7 would make any price tag they put on the bloody thing worth it).
